articles.h: Coach Prestige? At 2-10? Savoie Picks Stanford and I Need to Sit Down
articles.dek: A 3-star safety from Lancaster picked the Cardinal over Illinois, Duke and Fresno State because of Harrell's pull, which is a strange thing to type in a 2-10 season.
body: Let me get this straight. Stanford is 2-10, unranked, and 2-7 in the ACC, and the best recruit we landed this week listed Coach Prestige as his top priority. Prestige. Mine eyes. Somewhere a booster is choking on a chardonnay, and I'm not far behind.

But the fact sheet doesn't lie. M. Savoie, a Coverage Specialist and the No. 293 player in the country, out of Lancaster, picked Coach Harrell over Illinois, Duke and Fresno State. A source close to the kid told me, "He wanted to play for a guy he thought was going somewhere." Well, we beat Duke 28-24 in Week 15, so maybe the kid watched tape. I'll take the win and the safety.

The rest of the haul is fine, if not thrilling. Guard D. Hilliman (No. 490) chose us over Missouri. Dual-threat QB M. Kern (No. 554) picked us for playing time over Arizona State, UCLA and Hawai'i. Beating UCLA for anyone is a pleasure I will never apologize for. Playing time at quarterback, though, is a polite way of saying the depth chart is wide open, and I've seen that depth chart.

Here's the cold bucket. The class sits 62nd nationally, 14th in the ACC, with 31 commits and not a single four-star. Harrell is 12-13 at Stanford and can recruit. Now he has to coach them. Show me that Savoie pick wasn't a mirage, Coach.
